title: Editor build blockers R2: fx-diverge caps at L1 (mutation-exempt) + L1 ens-after-move (E0382) + L1 empty-literal->TString in struct-lit

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Close the 3 editor-build blockers + ship the verified editor (#83). (1) check.rs: add fn_is_diverge + diverge_l1_cert + GateOutcome::DivergeL1; gate_fn routes a non-boundary/non-slag fx-diverge fn to an L1 partial-correctness cap that continues like BoundaryL1/SlagL1 (no verus, no §7 mutation/strengthen) — honest + diverge-only. (2) l1.rs blocker 2: lower_fn_l1 snapshots non-Copy params an ens references into

__pre clones before the body, rewrites ens via rename_params_in_expr; TString/struct/enum derive Clone. (3) l1.rs blocker 3: Expr::StrLit (exec) materializes a TString (Vec byte-push, mirroring lower.rs #82). Tests: forge/tests/editor_runs.rs (edit core L3, run L1, build+run with piped keys, diverge-only regressions). README. Gauntlet: workspace test/clippy/fmt.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (deed870). 3 R2 blockers: (1) fx diverge -> L1 cap (mutation-exempt) via gate_fn fn_is_diverge -> DivergeL1, mirroring boundary_l1; (2) L1 ens-after-move fixed (snapshot non-Copy params .clone() pre-body + rename in ens); (3) L1 empty-literal -> TString in struct-lit. Critic NO DIVERGENCE: the diverge L1 cap is HONEST + strict + diverge-only — the effect-row firewall (a caller of a diverge fn must itself be diverge) means no L3 cert rests on a diverge fn's unverified ens; a non-diverge weak contract still -> L0; a vacuous diverge ens still rejects EnsIsTrivial. 540 tests.
